_README: YOUR DECISIONS. This file is empty on purpose — it is the shape, not the contents.
A ruling is a decision you have settled and do not want re-opened by accident: which
colour carries the error state, which spacing step the cards use, why you rejected the
pattern that looked obvious. Each one names the files it governs, so the next time
anyone touches those files the decision is put back in front of them.
Two rules make it worth trusting:
1. Nothing already written here is ever quietly reworded. To change your mind you
add a new ruling that supersedes the old one, and both stay readable.
2. You never hand-edit this file. Every entry goes in through
machinery/_inscribe_ruling.py, which refuses anything malformed before it writes.
FIRST-SESSION.md at the top of the pack walks you through inscribing your first one.
